notes.title: QoL and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
A laundry list of changes that should make the game more enjoyable!

Fixed an issue where enemies would not be hit around corners if full line of sight was not achieved

Made a few levels easier by removing enemies that caused frustrating interactions, such as spotting the player and alerting a gunman in areas where little counterplay existed

Slightly changed the center of the view when aiming to be more towards the player to reduce screen movement

Caleb's lunge now automatically removes lock-on for easier kick-off aiming

Rotated the camera in some levels/cutscenes to give a better view

notes.title: Aim Overhaul and Boss Changes
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571668/ee07aaceaa8f8e3790a285aff49d121d37fa278a.png"]

In today's update, For the Greater Good's camera and aiming systems have been completely overhauled. Now, the player aims with a crosshair, and the character will face toward it. You can lock the crosshair onto a specific enemy by pressing the lock-on button (middle click by default). The new system is less disorienting, feels a lot smoother, and requires much less mouse movement in situations that need precise aim. The lock-on function should also make bosses significantly easier since the player can focus on dodging. 

Aiming on controllers has changed to a twin-stick system with the same lock-on function.

The new aiming system will now be the default, and the old third person mode can be selected in the options.

A large selection of bosses have been toned down and reworked, especially ones with abilities that needed a large amount of trial and error to figure out. Combined with the new camera system, they should be much less frustrating.

Many S rating times have been adjusted since the new aim system seems a little slower to clear levels, but I will look into adjusting more of them if they are unreasonable.

notes.title: August 5, 2025 Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug preventing bosses from properly absorbing blood at lower framerates

Increased sound and mouse sens increments in the options menus to 5 and 0.05 respectively

Fixed a bug where skipping the last cutscene through the pause menu would skip the credits

Fixed a bug that made the mouse cursor visible during the credits

These changes have also been applied to the demo version of the game.

notes.title: Release! And future updates
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571668/cc69901f8f3a65b7b04cb6aa878958a6629bcb5c.png"]

For the Greater Good has officially been released! Fight through 4 acts of intense violence, meet some interesting characters, and experience the story’s twists and turns. And if that’s not enough, there are post-story challenge modes that range from fun to masochistic.



Some notable changes since the demo came out:

A new hint system when fighting bosses (press a button to reveal a hint after death)

Enemies with guns can be one-hit killed by any attack

The ability to skip any level in the story mode

You can now adjust your jump trajectory a bit while in the air



The demo has also been retroactively updated with these features.


If you find any bugs or have any suggestions, please make a post about it in For the Greater Good’s Steam forums. I’m also open to hearing feedback about the difficulty of specific bosses, etc.



Short-term future updates:

Free, unlockable skins you can earn by completing the post-story challenge modes

Adding a missing character’s picture to the main menu

Ironing out bugs



Translating the game:

I have made the game files easy to translate, so if the game reaches a moderate level of success, translating the game into various languages will be my top priority.

notes.title: Release Delay
notes.notes:
The game will be released this Friday, July 11th. 

Sorry and thank you for your patience.
